d:
Diabetes is not just about high blood sugar. Type 2 diabetes can affect several parts of the body, including the eyes, kidneys, heart, feet, teeth, gums and even sexual health. But how much do we really know about these complications?
In this special episode of Sehat, under USV's “Samajhdaar Bano, Sehat Ke Ishaare Samjho” initiative, we speak to leading diabetes and endocrinology experts about the complications of Type 2 Diabetes, early warning signs, essential health check-ups and ways to protect different organs.
Experts:
Dr. AJAY SHAH
MBBS; MD; DM (Endocrinology)
